<div class="inner-page">
<p class="section-label">News</p>

<h1>EKHI Database Launched</h1>

<p>We are pleased to announce the launch of <strong>EKHI</strong>, the first open-access database dedicated to optical and radiative property data.</p>

<p>EKHI provides publication-centered data organization with curve-level spectral datasets, inspection and download mechanisms, and full provenance tracking. Researchers can browse, visualize, and download emissivity and reflectance spectra contributed by laboratories across our network.</p>

<p><a href="/data/ekhi.html">Read the full EKHI application note</a> for details on the database structure, data formats, and how to contribute your measurements.</p>

<p><a href="https://ekhi.ehu.eus" class="btn btn-primary">Access the EKHI Database</a></p>
